description: Calculate the late fee on one overdue invoice: flat fee, monthly % or annual %, simple or compounding, with optional grace days. Returns days late, the fee, the new total and a line to paste on the invoice. Use payment_terms_check instead to work out when an invoice is due. Not legal advice; it does not look up state caps. Pure calculation: no network request, nothing is sent or stored. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input returns an error and is not charged.

as_of.description: Date paid, or the date to calculate to, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC)

compounding.description: false = simple interest (default); true = compounds (monthly: per 30 days; annual: daily)

fee_type.description: flat = one fixed fee; monthly_percent e.g. 1.5; annual_percent e.g. 18

flat_fee.description: Flat fee; required for fee_type=flat, optional one-time add-on otherwise

grace_days.description: Days after the due date before any fee applies

state.description: US state (2-letter) for the legal note

name: late_fee_calc
